meta.note: Objects flagged by Claude in Euclid DR1 cutouts. Unverified model suggestions, not discoveries.

finds.name: EO J041401.58-531138.4
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Long S-shaped, curved stellar stream about 12 arcsec long with a bright knot mid-way, connecting to a compact disc galaxy at its upper-left end; looks like an interacting/merging pair with tidal tails.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Tidally distorted merging galaxy pair with a long tidal tail, or a warped edge-on disc.

finds.name: EO J100215.87+661833.1
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Faint blue curved arclets and elongated blue knots wrapped around a red early-type galaxy just south of the brightest group elliptical; possible galaxy-group-scale strong lensing candidate.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Blue satellite or tidally disturbed star-forming galaxies projected near red group members.

finds.name: EO J041300.50-525304.4
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Thin faint streak about 2.4 arcsec south-west of the core of a large red elliptical, roughly tangential to it and bluer than the galaxy; possible gravitationally lensed arc. A second faint arclet lies upper right.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Edge-on faint satellite or background disc galaxy projected on the elliptical's halo.

finds.name: EO J041339.30-524625.4
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large face-on clumpy spiral whose bright core is a curved, banana-shaped bar ending in a hooked knot; a very bright blue star-forming clump on the left arm; faint red elongated background galaxies upper-left.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Disturbed barred spiral with a dust-lane-shaped nucleus and a giant star-forming clump.

finds.name: EO J041324.05-525919.2
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Disturbed barred spiral with asymmetric arms and a faint outer loop, a compact elongated companion superposed on its southern disc and a diffuse clump at the northern arm tip; likely interacting/merging system.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Ordinary spiral galaxy with chance-projected foreground or background galaxies near its disc.

finds.name: EO J041403.67-524918.5
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Blue, clumpy dwarf irregular galaxy with a bright elongated star-forming core, resolved into many compact knots or stars and clusters, embedded in a smooth diffuse halo; small faint patch on lower-left edge.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Nearby star-forming dwarf irregular galaxy partly resolved into stars and clusters.

finds.name: EO J100211.72+662715.0
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Faint thin arclet about 5.8 arcsec upper-right of a massive red elliptical, oriented tangentially to it; other faint smudges lie below the galaxy. Possible galaxy-scale strong-lens arc, blue relative to the lens.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Faint edge-on background or satellite galaxy aligned tangentially by chance.

finds.name: EO J041209.58-525954.5
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Chain of blue elongated blobs and a knot lying tangentially about 2 arcsec north of the bright saturated red central object with diffraction spikes; possible lensed arclets, though the central object may be a star.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Chance projection of faint blue background galaxies near a bright foreground star.

finds.name: EO J095927.41+662408.9
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Thin, slightly curved elongated streak about 3 arcsec south-west of the bright central early-type galaxy, oriented roughly tangentially to it; possible gravitationally lensed arc candidate. Rest of field is ordinary compact red galaxies.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Edge-on disc or tidally stretched satellite galaxy projected near the central galaxy.

finds.name: EO J034629.88-543813.9
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large inclined spiral with dust lanes and bright bulge; compact elongated companion at its upper-right end, embedded in a shared warped, asymmetric outer envelope suggesting tidal interaction. Many small background galaxies around.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Inclined spiral galaxy interacting with, or projected against, a smaller companion galaxy.

finds.name: EO J041127.84-525538.1
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Small faint clumpy ring about 2 arcsec across with a dark centre, bluish in the composite, visible in both visible-band stretches. Rest of field is ordinary red ellipticals and discs.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Clumpy star-forming or collisional ring galaxy, or chance grouping of faint blue clumps.

finds.name: EO J041133.59-525906.7
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Thin, slightly curved streak about 3 arcsec long extending up-right from the bright compact galaxy at centre, reddish in the colour composite. It points radially away from the galaxy, like a tidal tail rather than a tangential lensed arc.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Tidal tail from an interaction, or a chance-projected edge-on background galaxy.

finds.name: EO J041253.10-531252.7
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Edge-on disc galaxy with a dust lane, visibly bowed into a banana shape, beside a bright early-type companion about 8 arcseconds away. Faint straight streak down the left edge looks like an artefact.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Edge-on spiral warped by tidal interaction with neighbouring galaxy; left-edge streak is a trail artefact.

finds.name: EO J034704.87-543806.3
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Two red elliptical nuclei about 1.7 arcsec apart sharing a common diffuse halo, with a faint knot to the right, in a group of red galaxies. Upper galaxy shows a curved arm or tidal arc.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Merging or projected pair of early-type galaxies at a group/cluster centre; arc is a spiral arm or tidal tail.

finds.name: EO J034849.38-544341.7
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Thin, bluish, straight streak about 2 arcseconds long lying just left of a compact red galaxy near the field centre. It points roughly towards the galaxy rather than tangentially, so a lensed arc is unlikely.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Edge-on blue disc galaxy projected next to, or interacting with, a red early-type galaxy.

finds.name: EO J034906.02-542242.6
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Two red, infrared-bright nuclei about 1 arcsecond apart inside a common diffuse envelope, likely merging early-type galaxies. A faint red smudge lies to the south, with small bluish galaxies nearby.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Close merging or projected pair of red early-type galaxies in a small group.

finds.name: EO J034825.39-543201.5
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Face-on galaxy with a bright horizontal bar, a large smooth low-surface-brightness disc and faint knots or arm fragments around it. A small blue streak lies below-left at about (0.42, 0.70), oriented roughly radially.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Barred low-surface-brightness spiral with star-forming knots; streak is probably an edge-on background galaxy.

finds.name: EO J041225.90-524651.6
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Edge-on disc galaxy with a bright, compact, redder round source superposed at its north-east end; small clumpy companion below; several faint elongated arclet-like galaxies to the right, possibly weakly lensed background objects.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Edge-on spiral with a chance-projected foreground star or compact elliptical; unrelated background galaxies.

finds.name: EO J034736.97-544115.5
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large face-on disc galaxy with a red bulge and a thin, bluish, nearly closed ring or tightly wound arms, plus faint outer arcs. A saturated foreground star with diffraction spikes sits just north.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Ringed spiral galaxy with a star-forming resonance ring; bright foreground star nearby.

finds.name: EO J041143.78-525016.3
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large face-on barred spiral with an asymmetric, lopsided disc, clumpy blue star-forming knots and a bright off-centre bar; arms look disturbed. Smaller spiral and a bright star to the upper right, red background galaxies around.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Late-type barred spiral with star-forming clumps, possibly mildly disturbed by an interaction.

finds.name: EO J041358.39-525004.5
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large blue clumpy irregular galaxy with a bar-like bright core, many compact star-forming knots and a chain of clumps on its left side, embedded in a faint diffuse asymmetric envelope; an ordinary red spiral lies to the right.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Nearby star-forming irregular or Magellanic-type dwarf galaxy with HII knots, possibly mildly disturbed.

finds.name: EO J034715.01-543451.4
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Small hook-shaped blue arc curving beside a red compact blob at upper left. Field is dominated by the clumpy outer disc of a large spiral at the right edge, plus two yellow point sources at centre.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Irregular or interacting background galaxy pair seen in projection; large spiral with star-forming clumps; foreground stars.

finds.name: EO J034843.37-541606.3
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Bright face-on galaxy with asymmetric, disturbed inner structure: a one-sided spiral arm, clumpy bright patch east of the nucleus, dust lanes, embedded in a smooth round extended halo. Possible minor-merger remnant. Small masked pixels in colour tile.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Face-on spiral with lopsided arms and dust lanes, perhaps mildly disturbed by a past minor merger.

finds.name: EO J041237.34-525556.0
finds.harness: Claude Code 2.1.326, headless, Read tool only
finds.description: Large clumpy irregular galaxy with many bright blue star-forming knots, asymmetric off-centre bright region inside a smooth diffuse halo, faint plume on the left. Small background galaxies scattered around, including an edge-on above.
finds.ordinary_explanation: Nearby star-forming irregular or dwarf galaxy with HII knots, possibly mildly disturbed.
